podSecurityContext.description: Pod-level securityContext. runAsUser must be numeric — curlimages/curl's USER is the name `curl_user`, which the kubelet cannot verify against runAsNonRoot (the container then never starts, with CreateContainerConfigError and no logs).

hook.description: Render the Job as an ArgoCD hook. PostSync + BeforeHookCreation means it re-runs on every sync and the previous run's logs survive until the next one.

ttlSecondsAfterFinished.description: Null = no TTL, the finished Job stays as the record. A number makes the test recurring: the Job is GC'd, ArgoCD recreates it, the test re-runs.

unauthenticated.description: Negative probe: POST /pitch with no Authorization header must be rejected. Catches a stack whose auth-token Secret never materialised — /health is 200 while /pitch is wide open.

external.description: Second pass through the public HTTPRoute — gateway, hostname match and TLS chain.

hostname.description: FQDN on the HTTPRoute. Must be non-empty when enabled.

caConfigMap.description: trust-manager Bundle ConfigMap mounted at /etc/ssl/bundle and passed as --cacert. Empty disables the mount.

connectTo.description: Host to dial instead of `hostname` (curl --connect-to), keeping the original hostname for SNI, Host and certificate validation. Needed because a Cilium L2-announced LoadBalancer VIP is not reachable from Pods on the same cluster.

extraProbes.description: Additional components to liveness-probe: GET <path> on the in-cluster Service, and through the HTTPRoute too when `hostname` is set and the external pass is on. GET-only — these components carry no bearer token.

events.description: Posted one `post_event` call per entry, so no JSON parsing happens in sh. Values must not contain single quotes.

destination.description: Inert pass-through. Present so verify-catalog's probe values do not fail strict additionalProperties:false validation; the chart itself does not consume this field.
